title: La Légende des siècles tome III
summary: "La Légende des siècles tome III" by Victor Hugo is a collection of poems written between 1855 and 1876 and published in three series. This monumental work depicts the history and evolution of humanity through scattered scenes glimpsed on the wall of centuries. Hugo presents epic, lyric, and satiric poems featuring obscure and often invented figures who embody their ages.
